messages:
sara: Heads up — billing preview is showing negative token counts for a handful of EU tenants after yesterday's runtime deploy.

matt: saw that on the console this morning. any quick repro steps? which stage of the pipeline?

sara: repro: replayed ~10k events from Kafka for tenant-42 into the staging tally; totals went from 1.2M -> 1.1998M (a net -200 tokens). looks like duplicate/dedupe ordering issue in enrich stage.

amir: initial guess: route resolver started emitting both `route_tag` and `legacy_route` for the same request in 2.1.4, and our fingerprinting happens before we canonicalize tags. dedupe key currently = `fingerprint` only.

jen: also noticed the edge started adding `X-Tenant-Alias` header last week. if the alias flips mid-session the enricher can enrich two different route attributes for the same logical request.

ops-bot: :warning: alert triggered: billing-preview-delta > 5% for EU region (rule: billing-anomaly-monitor).

kevin: can we confirm the exact dedupe key? code in tally reads: `dedupe_key = fingerprint` (no tenant/request id).

matt: yep that's it. we assumed fingerprint stable but alias rewrite breaks that.

sara: likely fixes: (A) include `request_id` or `tenant_session_id` in dedupe when available, (B) normalize tenant alias mapping earlier in the pipeline before fingerprinting, or (C) change fingerprinting to include canonical route tag.

jen: caveat: `request_id` isn't present for some embedding routes today — clients drop it.

amir: my preference is B: canonicalize route/tenant alias in the edge/enricher as the first enrichment step. then fingerprint/unify. minimal churn to dedupe semantics.

matt: implementation note: add a `dedupe_version` tag so we can run old/new comparisons in preview rather than flipping live logic immediately.

kevin: good call. we should emit both legacy_count and v2_count to `billing.preview` topic for the canary. add metric `preview.delta_by_dedup_version`.

sara: reconciliation ops: we'll run an offline script to compute expected invoice delta and if >0.5% per tenant we'll queue patches / credit adjustments.

jen: also UX ask: console should show side-by-side raw event stream vs de-duped totals for the tenant in preview mode, and show which dedupe_version produced which total. SAs need traceability.

matt: quick config sketch (will put in PR):
```
# enricher config
canonicalize:
  enable_alias_map: true
fingerprint:
  version: v2
  include: [fingerprint, tenant_session_id? , request_id?]
```

matt: downside: if we change dedupe key now, historic records will be reconciled differently -> invoice deltas. hence the soft rollout approach.

amir: I'll own the canary rollout. plan: produce to `billing.preview` with both counts for 1% of tenants for 72h, then 10% if stable.

kevin: I'll add a dashboard card: `dedupe_version_compare`, `negative_count_alert` and a histogram of per-tenant deltas. also add alert for sustained >0.1% drift.

sara: ops runbook: if negative counts appear, rollback canary, and run reconciliation compute to generate credits. need runbook steps and peg to SLA comms.

matt: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321 (enricher canonicalization + dedupe_version feature flag).

amir: canary runbook: https://internal.redwood/sre/runbooks/enricher-canonicalize (added, includes rollback steps and kafka replay checklist).

jen: I'll open clientlib docs PR to recommend propagating `request_id` for embeddings routes consistently.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: `enricher v2.1.5-canary` -> 1% tenants on 2026-03-27T09:00Z.

kevin: timeline? we want this live for revenue-sensitive tenants before month-end.

matt: target: PR merged Thurs EOD, canary Fri morning, monitor 72h, expand Monday if green.

sara: followups assigned: matt -> PR + tests, amir -> canary + runbook + dashboard hooks, jen -> clientlib docs, kevin -> dashboard panels & alerts, ops -> reconciliation script and crediting playbook.

matt: quick note for audit: include `dedupe_version` and `canonicalization_map_version` in event audit headers so forensic queries can filter quickly.

jen: agreed. also log the `alias_change` flag for each enriched event so we can identify rewrite-induced pairs.

sara: thanks all. will loop back after first 24h of canary. if drift >1% open postmortem and coordinate customer comms.

matt: ping me on thread if anything spikes.

amir: acknowledged, starting canary prep.

sara: closing thread for now. will reopen if we see anomalies.
